verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail ships AI features (AI summaries and automatic labels), so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer mail is used to train AI models. The axis therefore applies. The evidence pack documents encryption, 2FA, access-controlled facilities and secure shredding, but nothing about an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
